0022600131.text: The Trail Blazers (2-0, second in the Northwest and fourth in the West) visit the Lakers (2-0, first in the Pacific and first in the West) in Portland's third game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams unbeaten so far. Portland is missing Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, and Portland won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 132-116 win in Portland on January 17, 2026.
